optimized_sql:
WITH
filtered_cd1 AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_customer_addr AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_birth_year,
           ca.ca_country,
           ca.ca_state,
           ca.ca_county
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2
      ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
)
SELECT rolled.i_item_id,
       rolled.ca_country,
       rolled.ca_state,
       rolled.ca_county,
       rolled.agg1,
       rolled.agg2,
       rolled.agg3,
       rolled.agg4,
       rolled.agg5,
       rolled.agg6,
       rolled.agg7
FROM (
    SELECT i.i_item_id,
           a.ca_country,
           a.ca_state,
           a.ca_county,
           AVG(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg1,
           AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg2,
           AVG(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg3,
           AVG(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg4,
           AVG(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg5,
           AVG(CAST(a.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg6,
           AVG(CAST(filtered_cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg7
    FROM filtered_date
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_cd1
      ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = filtered_cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN filtered_customer_addr a
      ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = a.c_customer_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, a.ca_country, a.ca_state, a.ca_county
    WITH ROLLUP
) AS rolled
ORDER BY rolled.ca_country, rolled.ca_state, rolled.ca_county, rolled.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
